response.sql: WITH item_stats AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.product_price IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN ili.product_price / ili.derived_total_cost ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as line_item_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios, AVG(line_item_count) as avg_line_item_count FROM item_stats
